disclosures.fig3_l2_identification: L2 is the N=4 left-chain subcell between alpha=1/5 and 1/4, derived from the paper's beta=(N+beta')^-1 map.
disclosures.fig4_c2_identification: C2 is the center-chain subcell between alpha=2/5 and 3/7, derived from beta=(2+1/alpha')^-1 and beta'=frac(alpha').
disclosures.fig5_rational_cutoff: The paper fixes delta-alpha=1/100 but not its numerical rational cutoff; q<80 is an independently converged raster representation of the defined union.
